_comment: Template only -- copy to models/manifest.json and fill in the real hashes after you place the actual .onnx artifacts in this directory. See onnx_nsfw_pipeline.py's 'Bringing your own models' doc. onnx_nsfw_pipeline.initialize() verifies each configured model file's SHA-256 against this manifest before loading, and fails closed (pipeline stays NOT READY, Claude fallback stays active) on a mismatch -- this is what catches an accidental or unauthorized model swap silently changing moderation behavior. Compute a hash with: shasum -a 256 models/nsfw_classifier.onnx
